name: Radio Bemba Festa Latina
description: Dance the night away to the sounds of Salsa, Cumbia, and Reggaeton at the historic Hard Club. This late-night party promises a high-energy start to your weekend.
longDescription:
Radio Bemba Festa Latina is a late-night event dedicated to Latin American music genres, including Salsa, Cumbia, and Reggaeton. This party is presented by an unspecified organizer and aims to provide an energetic atmosphere for dancing. The event takes place at Hard Club, a known venue in Porto for music and nightlife.

Attendees can expect an evening focused on dance music from various Latin American traditions. The event is scheduled to begin late on a Friday night, suggesting a focus on adult audiences seeking a lively start to the weekend. Hard Club is a historic building, formerly a market, which now functions as a cultural space and concert venue, offering a distinct backdrop for the event.

Ticket prices for Radio Bemba Festa Latina vary, and it is advisable to check in advance for purchase options. Hard Club is located in the city center, within walking distance of São Bento metro station and train station, and is also served by various bus lines. Information regarding accessibility for individuals with mobility impairments is not specified.
